summary: The note is a short encyclopedia-style entry on Khong District, a district (muang) of Champassack Province in southwestern Laos. It notes the district's border with Cambodia in the far south and its fame for the Khonephapheng Waterfalls and the Si Phan Don (4000 Islands) area.
one_line: Khong District is a district of Champassack Province in southwestern Laos, bordering Cambodia and known for the Khonephapheng Waterfalls and Si Phan Don.
key_facts: Khong is a district (muang) of Champassack Province in southwestern Laos.
Khong District borders Cambodia in the far south.
Khong District is famous for the Khonephapheng Waterfalls.
Khong District is famous for the Si Phan Don (4000 Islands) area.
